Name: Flowery Pink Houses
Author: naeldeus
Description:
this mod changes the look of your house and other buildings! i wanted some pink buildings with cute accents without being too over the top and this is what i came up with. it’s my first seasonal buildings and i feel like i learned a lot. it took so much work, so please enjoy!

[center][color=#ffffff][url=https://ko-fi.com/naeldeus]consider buying me a coffee if you enjoy my mods and wish to support me![/url]﻿[/color][/center]

[b]features:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]seasonal[/b] sprites for the farmhouse buildings
[*][i]new [/i]updated cabin sprites for sdv 1.4
[*][i]new [/i]added a big shed, same model as the shed, but now it won't switch to vanilla when you upgrade
[/list]

[b]installation:
[/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*]that’s it, enjoy!
[/list]

[/list]
